_comment: Structural map of mealbudgeter.html for fast lookup before edits. Line numbers are a snapshot (regenerate after large edits). The Android port mealbudgeter-android/www/index.html is a byte-identical copy — always re-sync after editing the main file.

meta.androidPort: mealbudgeter-android/www/index.html (must stay byte-identical; copy after every change)
meta.type: single self-contained HTML file (inline CSS + vanilla JS, no build step, no deps except runtime APIs below)
meta.hostEnvironment: Often run inside html-runner-android (see C:/Users/Kristophoros/Desktop/ClaudeCodeProjects/html-runner-android/map.json) — a Capacitor WebView launcher that installs this app from a .zip and navigates its WebView (window.location.href) to the app's index.html under https://localhost/_capacitor_file_/... There is NO browser chrome/download manager in that WebView, and NO Capacitor JS bridge is available inside this page (the bridge only attaches to the launcher's own index.html, not pages it navigates to). Consequence: <a download> silently no-ops there. Anything that needs to get a file OUT of the app (export, share) must not rely on the browser download flow alone — see exportModal.

runtimeAPIs.navigator.share / navigator.canShare: used by both the shopping-list share and the export modal; the only reliable 'get a file out' path inside the WebView host. Both features also have a clipboard/textarea fallback that works with zero platform APIs.

tabs.note: 5 tabs; icon+label buttons (span.tab-ico + span.tab-lbl, data-i18n on label). Labels hidden on mobile (icon-only). Default active = home. switchTab(name); home nav cards use [data-goto].

tab-home.layout: hero -> home-nav-title 'Get started' -> home-nav (4-col grid, nav cards ABOVE) -> home-nav-title 'This week' -> home-summary (6-col 1x6 grid BELOW)

slotModal.note: ONE generic item picker, reused for both sub-slots of a cell. Which sub-slot it's editing is carried in activeSlot.part ('meal'|'drink'), not in separate fields.

exportModal.note: WebView-safe backup export. textarea pre-filled with the JSON; three explicit actions rather than one 'download' click.
buttons: shareExportBtn(navigator.share w/ File, hidden if unsupported)

slotModel.shape: mealPlan[day][mealTypeId] = null | { meal: ref|null, drink: ref|null }
slotModel.ref: { recipeId, qty } (a recipe) | { ingredientId, qty } (a pantry item planned directly)
slotModel.note: Each meal type renders as TWO physical table rows (a 'Meal' row and an 'Extra' row), not two spans inside one cell — see renderPlanner. The meal-col label cell has rowspan=2 and acts as the title for the pair. Row 1 buttons have data-part='meal' (food-only picker); row 2 buttons have data-part='drink' (UNRESTRICTED picker — food or beverage; it's a place for a beverage OR a second food/ingredient, not beverage-exclusive — see fillSlotSelect(select, null)). resolveRef() resolves a single ref; slotMeal()/slotDrink() get the two sub-refs; slotCost() sums both. openSlotModal(day, mealTypeId, part) opens ONE generic picker scoped to that part; save/clear only ever touch their own part, preserving the other. Legacy single-ref/string/dual-picker slots are auto-migrated in loadState (routed to meal or drink by the item's category).

slotMeal.note: meal sub-ref (tolerates legacy single-ref/string as meal)

slotCost.note: meal.cost + drink.cost for a whole cell (both physical rows combined)

loadState.note: defaults + migrations: string slot -> {recipeId,qty}; single-ref/dual-picker slot -> {meal,drink} routed by category; backfill mealTypes/mealPlan keys; shopping* maps.

switchTab.note: wired to tab-btns and [data-goto] home cards

deleteIngredient.note: clears recipes + meal/drink sub-slots + shopping* maps

renderPlanner.note: KEY. Renders 2 <tr> per meal type (mealtype-row-a = Meal, mealtype-row-b = Extra), label cell rowspan=2. Extra-row buttons get class .slot-btn-extra (accent-colored when filled).

fillSlotSelect.note: (select, category) category='food'|'beverage' filters; category=null shows everything unfiltered. Options always catIcon-prefixed, grouped Recipes/Pantry, values r:/i:

openSlotModal.note: part='meal' -> food-only picker; part='drink' -> unrestricted picker. Single generic slotItemSelect/slotItemQty, relabeled per part via t('field_meal')/t('field_extra').

randomizeHandler.note: pool = food-category recipes + food-category ingredients; sets MEAL sub-slot only, PRESERVES existing drink/extra; confirm if meals exist

renderShoppingList.note: TWO-ROW card: .shopping-main (checkbox+name+🥤+tag) then .shopping-detail (qty+cost+remove ✕). Refresh btn clears shoppingExcluded.

buildReportText.note: weekly plan lines show 'Meal + 🥤 Extra — cost' via resolveRef(meal)/resolveRef(drink)+slotCost

renderHome.note: summary: weeklyCost, budget left (under/over), #recipes, #ingredients, #beverages (recipes+ingredients category==='beverage'), #planned via slotFilled

keyEventHandlers.note: anonymous listeners near their section; search 'getElementById("<id>").addEventListener'
keyEventHandlers.slotSaveBtn/slotClearBtn: PLANNER ~1911-1930 (operate on activeSlot.part only, preserve the other sub-ref)
keyEventHandlers.copyExportBtn/downloadExportBtn/shareExp: SETTINGS, right after exportDataBtn — shareExportBtn hidden set on open via `!navigator.share`
keyEventHandlers.importDataFile: SETTINGS (unchanged; FileReader + confirm-before-overwrite; re-runs loadState migrations)

stateSchema.ingredients: [{ id, name, category:'food'|'beverage', unit, pricePerUnit:Number, lastUpdated:ms, translations:{[lang]:String} }]
stateSchema.recipes: [{ id, name, category:'food'|'beverage', ingredients:[{ ingredientId, quantity:Number }] }]
stateSchema.mealTypes: [{ id, order:Number, labelKey?(builtin i18n key), name?(custom) }] (builtins breakfast/lunch/dinner)
stateSchema.mealPlan: { [day monday..sunday]: { [mealTypeId]: null | { meal: ref|null, drink: ref|null } } }; ref = {recipeId,qty} | {ingredientId,qty}. Legacy shapes auto-migrated.

conventions.singleFile: One HTML file. Android port is a plain copy. Do NOT split into external .js unless asked.
conventions.i18n: I18N.en (833) / I18N.es (961), mirrored. Static: data-i18n / data-i18n-placeholder (works on <option>/<span>). Dynamic: t(key,vars). ADD NEW KEYS TO BOTH. Never translate user data except the ingredient-translation feature. Prefer repurposing a now-unused key's VALUE over leaving dead keys around (e.g. field_drink -> field_extra) when a feature's wording changes.
conventions.beverages: category:'food'|'beverage' on ingredients AND recipes = eatable vs drinkable. Meal row picker = food only; Extra row picker = unrestricted (food or beverage). catIcon() renders 🥤.
conventions.webviewSafety: Never assume <a download> or window.open works — the Android host WebView has no download manager and no window.open target. Any 'get data out of the app' feature needs navigator.share (primary) with a copyable-text fallback (guaranteed). See exportModal for the reference pattern.
conventions.afterEdit: 1) browser test (server 'mealbudgeter' port 3134 /mealbudgeter.html) no console errors; 2) copy mealbudgeter.html -> mealbudgeter-android/www/index.html; 3) regenerate this map if structure shifted.

i18nKeysAddedThisIteration: field_extra (replaces the now-unused field_drink; label for the Extra/second-row picker), add_extra (empty-state text for the Extra row's + Add button), export_title, export_hint, btn_download. randomize_no_recipes and planner_empty text unchanged from prior iteration.
